proposal.source:
function unifiedDiff(_cap, before, after, label) { if (before === after) return ''; const oldLines = before.split('
'), newLines = after.split('
'), name = label || 'file'; const body = []; for (const line of oldLines) body.push('-' + line); for (const line of newLines) body.push('+' + line); return '--- a/' + name + '
+++ b/' + name + '
@@ -1,' + oldLines.length + ' +1,' + newLines.length + ' @@
' + body.join('
'); }
proposal.description: Format a deterministic whole-file unified diff for two text values.

exports.name: unifiedDiff
exports.signature: (before: string, after: string, label?: string) => string
